# Contract: platform-video-export

Third-party skill from [xianyu110/ecommerce-video-skills](https://github.com/xianyu110/ecommerce-video-skills) (MIT, xianyu110), `96c49b3`. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Publish packaging: aspect ratio and encode for upload). The method is upstream. Category: video. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Re-encode one finished master to the aspect ratios and H.264 settings common platforms expect, and write an export report.

## Use it for
- "export this master for several platforms"
- "make a 9:16 and a 1:1 from this video"

## Not for
- editing the story (vlog-auto-edit or rough-cut)
- colour grading

## Accepted inputs
A finished master video and the platforms to target.

## Deliverables
One file per preset and export_report.json.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Optional:
- none
